scope: Korean EGA III-1 and subsequent in-scope volume production
user_directive: Multiple QA loops are forbidden. QA loops per small section are forbidden.
execution_rule: After the complete volume candidate is assembled, perform at most one finite aggregate whole-volume content-QA transaction and at most one finite aggregate whole-release output-validation transaction. Do not subdivide either into recurring section reviews, do not restart either review from the beginning, and do not create a QA loop around individual units. Apply findings from the single content pass once. Ordinary one-shot hash, parse, build, packaging, publication, and public-byte identity operations are integrity transactions, not invitations to rerun QA.
